data.text: (h/t @GuptaRK22, who I was chatting with as I had this realization, while HE was on Sand Hill Rd 😉)

I just realized that it's been years since I've been to Sand Hill Road.

My last meeting there was in 2019.

It's an amusing duality:
- SF is back
- Sand Hill Rd is dead

Overall representative of the gravity of builders—most VCs I know are launching primary offices in SF.

Christopher Nolan's new movie Oppenheimer is a biopic about the Manhattan Project, set in Los Alamos, New Mexico—where I grew up.

It is surreal how critical my small town of 13,000 was to the fate of the world.

Hard to not feel the same about AI today...
